## `[apple_drops]`

Apples dropped by leaves (when broken without shears or Silk Touch, or when decaying)

|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` |  | Use the chances below instead of the vanilla ones. Applied on /reload |

| `other_leaves` | `false` |  | Let all other leaves (birch, spruce, jungle, acacia, cherry, mangrove, azalea, modded leaves...) drop apples |

## `[campfire_protection]`

Lit campfires stop hostile mobs from spawning naturally around them (server side)

| Option | Default | Range or values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` |  | Turn the protection on or off. Applied on /reload |
| `radius` | `16` | 1 to 64 | Horizontal radius in blocks around the campfire |
| `vertical_radius` | `8` | 1 to 64 | Vertical distance in blocks above and below the campfire (keeps caves under a base from being protected) |
| `require_lit` | `true` |  | Only lit campfires protect |
| `soul_campfire` | `true` |  | Soul campfires protect too |
| `affect_spawners` | `false` |  | Also block monster spawners and trial spawners (off by default so mob farms keep working) |
| `excluded_mobs` | `[]` | list of ids, e.g. ["minecraft:creeper"] | Mobs that can still spawn near a campfire, e.g. ["minecraft:creeper", "minecraft:slime"] |
